name: new-project
description: Two skills for the documentation-first method. new-project sets up a repo: documentation kit (CLAUDE.md, plan, task cards, status, ADRs, handovers, project skills, hooks, review agents), the mattpocock-skills and ponytail plugins, and tasks that explain themselves, also from a prototype or other reference. start-session opens each working session: reads the documents, asks which tasks, loads the plugin skills the work needs.
